VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES

Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:09 PM, Vice Chair Atkins Blade called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Earl, Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator, Gustavo Orozco, Attendee.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Earl led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56374  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission

  A motion was made by Commissioner Goodin, seconded by Commissioner
  Hardimon, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Earl, Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-56375  Recommendation to review, approve, and if necessary, provide updates to the FY
  2026 Budget Request.

  Page 1 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 3, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815

  A motion was made by Chair Osborn, seconded by Commissioner Sramek, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Earl, Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  25-56376  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Veterans Banner Ad Hoc
  Committee.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Goodin, seconded by Commissioner
  Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Earl, Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  The event on August 30 at New Hope was a success. An estimated 60 people
  showed up, representing 18 of the 2025 banner honorees.

4.  25-56377  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the Veterans Day Celebration to
  be held on November 8, 2025, and discuss event logistics.

  A motion was made by Chair Osborn, seconded by Commissioner Earl, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Earl, Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  The Veterans Day committee comprises Commissioners Atkins Blade, Sramek,
  Hardimon, and Goodin. Its first meeting is on 9/11. (This is separate from the
  check-ins with Special Events). The Commission considered honorees for the
  Veterans Recognition Ceremony, and including a special “In Memoriam” in honor of
  Skip Keesal; a vendor to sell Veterans merchandise (t-shirts, pins, hats, et al.);
  Commissioner volunteers to staff the OVS booth; which local organizations are a
  good fit for the Resources Fair, and promoting the event. Staff invited
  Commissioners to attend the presentation to Council on October 14.

  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment: Gus Orozco, president of Long Beach Veterans Day Committee, will be organizing a
reception for the Veterans Banner Program families (for both years, 2024 and 2025) to take place in
the days before the Veterans Day Celebration on November 8. He is seeking venues and additional
sponsors and asked Commissioners to reach out to him with input.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Two Veteran Stand Down events coming up: one September 20-22, at the Compton Housing
Authority in Compton, and the other on October 3, at Grijalva Park in Orange.

ADJOURNMENT

Vice Chair Atkins Blade adjourned the meeting at 6:15 p.m.
